text: He has been very fussy and shows decreased interest in feeding for the past few days, but I believe he is still gaining weight. There have been no episodes of vomiting or diarrhea, just a distended abdomen that seems to make him cry intensely when touched. The X-ray findings of dilated bowel segments with no rectal gas are highly suggestive of Hirschsprung disease. I need to confirm the absence of ganglion cells, so I will request a rectal suction biopsy.

REQUEST TEST: Rectal_Suction_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Rectal Suction Biopsy: Absence of ganglion cells in the submucosal and myenteric plexuses, confirming the diagnosis of Hirschsprung disease.
